top_choice_rationale: P003 honours a single, coherent design principle: heterobifunctional molecules that recruit E3 ligases and turn the cell's ubiquitin-proteasome machinery into catalytic, event-driven pharmacology, independently adopted by many groups. Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli carry separable, checkable contributions (concept and proof, E3 recruitment and cullin biology, structure-guided VHL ligands). The weaknesses are no approved PROTAC yet and the cereblon/glue strand left outside the three names, but I judge them smaller than the credit, maturity or coherence problems of the other proposals. P001 is my second choice because B023 has the cleanest credit and B060 is a real chemical-biology capability, though the pairing is pragmatic and Liu alone leaves out Komor and Gaudelli, and I doubt B060 adds a distinct chemical principle beyond 2020. P004 follows because the founding in vitro and P-granule results are secure but Pappu and Mittag cannot be named; P002 follows given unresolved stability and lead toxicity, with contested credit among six contributors. No award is last, since every slate proposal honours real work.
